title: docs(ui): re-take the react-block-needs-record-context transcript from os validate; the close-out census reads 0 author-time ids over 200
body:
Fixes #22161
Clause-②: no

The close-out slice of the card. It does two things. It takes the census the close condition asks for, as a reading on `main`. It also re-takes the one stale docs transcript that slice 15's landing (`6136999237`) carried to this slice. The census reads **0 author-time `packages/lint` ids firing a hint or `fix:` over 200 characters**, so this PR closes the card. The `domain:cli` half is a separate card: #22841 remains open, and nothing here touches it.

Claim: `6248840553`. It is the newest `Claim:` on the card and it names this branch. I checked that before any edit.

Cross-lane declaration: `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx` belongs to `domain:devx` by the domain table. This one transcript block is carried here by triage `6109231286` and slice 15's landing `6136999237`. Nothing else in `content/docs/**` is touched.

## The close condition, read on `main`

The condition (triage `6219576699`): "no author-time `packages/lint` id fires a hint or `fix:` over 200 characters, item 3's slice has landed, and the close-out slice's carries are done." Item 3's slices 11–21 have landed; slice 21 landed as `9c74d4098d`. The carries are the transcript below and this census.

All readings are on `main` at `21070a2f0` (this branch's base), in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`. `main` then moved to `30da04f8e`, and the branch merges it. None of those 3 commits touches `packages/lint`, `packages/cli`, `packages/formula`, `packages/sdui-parser` or `packages/spec/src`: `git diff --quiet 21070a2f0 HEAD` over those paths exits 0. So the reading also holds at this PR's head.

**Instrument 1: a fire census over the whole lint suite.** It is a copy of slice 21's preload. `Array.prototype` push / unshift / map / filter / forEach / find / findIndex / some / every / flatMap / concat / slice hooks record every finding-shaped object the suite handles: a string `rule` and `message`, plus `hint`, `fix`, `where`, `path` and `severity`. My copy drops slice 21's "must carry a hint" filter, so it also counts ids that fire without one. It runs as scratch tooling and is never committed.

- Run: `packages/lint`, 144 files / 6857 tests passed, VERDICT 0 (verify lock, slot `issue-22161-co`). That gives 4379 distinct finding rows.
- **240 ids fire.** 239 carry a hint or `fix:` string. One of those is `expression-invalid`'s empty hint, which is by design: the CLI prints no `fix:` line for it. `relationship/missing-reference` carries none.
- **Over 200: 3 ids, all outside the condition.** They are the repo-gate ids in `lint-startup-registry-verdict.ts`: `startup-open-vocabulary-verdict` 972, `startup-verdict-assertive-wording` 972 and `startup-source-unparseable` 254.
- **Author-time ids over 200: 0.** 237 author-time ids fire (8 of them are the spec's `functional-completeness.ts` ids, which the lint suite runs). The longest hint is 200, from `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` (`GROUP_ONLY_FIX`). Next come 199 (`sharing-rule-unlowerable-condition`, `semantic-role-field-unprovisioned`), 198 (`flow-bare-dollar-reference`, `filter-preset-comparand`) and 197 (`rls-predicate-over-budget`). No hint has a line break.
- **Controls.** Two known ids must be seen, and both are: `react-block-needs-record-context` (5 distinct hints, longest 195) and the card's own `field-no-consumers` (16 distinct, longest 175). The instrument also records over-200 text when it fires: the 3 repo-gate ids are recorded at 972 / 972 / 254. Slice 21's preload, unmodified, reads the same suite as 4376 rows / 239 ids with the same 3 over 200. My copy adds exactly the 3 hint-less `relationship/missing-reference` rows.

**Instrument 2: a static floor over the source.** It is a TypeScript AST walk of every `hint:` / `fix:` property in `packages/lint/src`'s 97 non-test files. For each site it counts the characters the source fixes, whatever the fixture: string literals, template heads and spans, `+` chains, and same-file string constants. Calls and parameters count 0, so each reading is a floor.

- 281 sites. Only 2 have fixed text over 200: `lint-startup-registry-verdict.ts:743` and `:769`, the two 972-character repo-gate hints.
- The two instruments agree where they can be compared. `GROUP_ONLY_FIX` reads 200 in both.

**Census-invisible ids (exported or named, never fired by the suite).** I enumerated the ids statically: the values at every `rule:` position (literals, and identifiers resolved to string constants) together with every exported id-shaped string constant. That gives 249 ids, of which 233 fire. The 7 `jsx-*` ids also fire, through the one template-literal id site (`validate-jsx-pages.ts:66`). The 16 that do not fire:

- **9 are `packages/cli`'s, not `packages/lint`'s.** `packages/lint` holds only their `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` entries; the ids are emitted in `packages/cli` (`utils/collect-docs.ts`, `lint/hook-body-lowering.ts`, `utils/picklist-references.ts`). They are `docs/duplicate-name`, `docs/frontmatter-tags`, `docs/nav-target`, `docs/uncollected-directory`, `hook-body/bundled-fallback`, `hook-body/extraction-failed`, `hook-body/not-lowerable`, `hook-body/unparseable` and `picklist-reference-unverified`. They are the `domain:cli` half.
- **1 is emitted by `packages/spec`:** `view/row-color-unresolvable-value` (`functional-completeness.ts`). Its `fix:` is 59 fixed characters plus the field name.
- **1 is not an id:** `condition`. It is an alias-map value quoted in a comment in `validate-expressions.ts`.
- **5 are `packages/lint` ids the suite never fires**, read from source:
  - `authoring-rule-threw` (`runtime-gate.ts`): a fully static hint of 131 characters.
  - `relationship/association-inline-edit`: a static `fix:` of 54.
  - `rollup/missing-summary`: a `fix:` of 27 fixed characters plus the child object and field names.
  - `chart-config-missing`: no emit site. The id is kept so `suppressWarnings` entries keep parsing.
  - `react-prop-deprecated`: the hint is the react-blocks contract's own deprecation `note`. On `main` the contract (`REACT_BLOCKS`, 4 blocks) declares 0 deprecated interactions, so the id cannot fire. Its sibling's notes (`REACT_RETIRED_OVERLAY_PROPS`, 2 entries) are at most 129.

**At the public door.** `os validate` on `examples/app-showcase`, unmodified, built CLI at `21070a2f0`: exit 0, `Running author-time rules (49)`, 64 warnings, 64 `fix:` lines from 5 rule ids. The longest are 200 (`approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty`) and 199 (`field-no-consumers`).

## The transcript

`content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx`, in the `record:*`-blocks section, holds the bare fence at `:360`–`:365`. Three of its four lines no longer matched what the rule prints:

- **the verdict line:** the one-sentence message ("…which reads its record from a record page's context; a kind:'react' page mounts none, so the block renders empty") replaces the old two-clause one;
- **the `fix:` line:** it now opens with `Instead:` and no longer says "On a react page bind the record yourself:" (slice 15's one-line shape);
- **the `rule:` line:** the path is `pages[28].source` (it was `pages[27]`), and the line now carries the pointer "`os explain react-block-needs-record-context` for why a record block renders empty on a react page".

**How it was taken: from a real run, not by hand.** I built the showcase's dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-showcase^...`, 63 tasks, VERDICT 0). Then I planted RecordHighlights on the showcase renewals page, the page this transcript has always been taken from. The plant swapped the view-mode ObjectForm for `RecordHighlights objectName="showcase_account" recordId={sel}`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. That mode checks that the anchor hits exactly once and that the blob changed, and it restores by absolute path. Then I ran `node ../../packages/cli/bin/run.js validate` from `examples/app-showcase`. The run exited 1 with `Author-time rules failed (1 issue)`. The four lines from `✗` through `rule:` were copied byte for byte out of that log into the fence, by a script that asserts each line's prefix. The page restore is proven: blob `fd28f319b1` equals `HEAD`'s, `git diff HEAD` is empty and the status is clean.

My first attempt was a no-op. Its replacement contained the anchor text, so `ablation-replace` refused (anchor count 1 → 1), the command never ran, and the page was restored. The second attempt used the anchor above.

The fence, its language-less info string and the surrounding prose are unchanged. `pnpm check:docs-transcript-drift` is not this block's judge. Its header pins only the registry-derived author-time rule count, in blocks declared `transcript=KIND`. This block is a bare fence, and its `Author-time rules failed (1 issue)` is a different sentence the gate deliberately does not match. `--list` shows 4 declared values across 417 pages, all `ok` (49 = 49), and none is this block. The edited page compiles through `@mdx-js/mdx`.

## Verification

Final head `609c99c07` (this branch's commit `eb0e3b839` plus a clean merge of `origin/main` `30da04f8e`). Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths, at `609c99c07`: 40 families over 1 path since merge base `30da04f8e`. That is identical to the PM's derivation. All 40 were run one by one and all exit 0.
  - `check:skill-examples` first exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: `packages/client-react` was unbuilt), so it measured nothing. I built that package directly and re-ran the gate: 262 marked examples type-check, exit 0.
  - `--ran`: "40 derived, 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0.
  - For every family CI runs, this PR's own check-runs are the reading.
- **Not owed locally:** `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness`, since the diff touches neither a `packages/spec` build input nor the four-axis frame files. Nor is any package test or typecheck, since the diff touches no package.
- **Control characters:** `grep -naP` over the changed file and this body finds nothing (exit 1).

## Acceptance notes

- **The next transcript on the same page is off by one page index.** The `react-prop-missing-required` block at `:402`–`:407` says `at pages[27].source`. The same planted-run method (ObjectChart's `objectName` removed on the renewals page) prints `pages[28].source`. Its verdict, `fix:` and `rule:` lines are otherwise byte-identical to the page. The block is outside this claim's file surface, which names the record-context block only, so it is left as written. A one-token docs edit takes it. Not filed: it is index drift in an elided example, and no defect class applies.
- **The 200-character bound is measured over fixtures and the showcase, as in slices 11–21.** Some fix lines interpolate author names. The card's own `field-no-consumers` prints 199 on the showcase, against 175 in the suite, because its line quotes the first carrier path. A longer object or field name pushes it past 200. The static floor names 10 author-time sites whose fixed text is 150–200 and which interpolate. The highest is `field-group-shadowed` at 192.
- `os explain` was not run. This slice changes no explanation.
